title: Armed operations begin in the CHT
detail: According to Banglapedia summaries, Shanti Bahini began armed operations in early 1976 after earlier autonomy demands failed to secure constitutional outcomes.

title: Conflict and displacement intensify
detail: The conflict expanded into a prolonged insurgency-counterinsurgency cycle, producing repeated violence, militarization, and displacement across hill communities.

title: CHT Peace Accord signed
detail: The Government of Bangladesh and PCJSS signed the Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord, formally ending the decades-long insurgency phase tied to Shanti Bahini operations.
